title: RED LINE: Car Chase BGM (original score)
description:
A night car chase from ignition to escape: a racing heartbeat, one hard brake that stops everything dead, then a konnakol surprise.

For fans of chase music, action thriller BGM and edits that need a pulse. Headphones on, volume up.

Music: Red Line, an original score by ÆTHER. Composed for ÆTHER, made with AI.
